title: No Verified Incident, No Honest Defense of Dog-Meat Trade
excerpt: No court, police, or health record here verifies a pet-theft case or seizure. Public safety still demands quarantine, transparency, and abolition by 2030.
body_html:
No verified police seizure, court conviction, intercepted shipment, or emergency alert is available here to establish a specific incident. That absence does not prove the trade safe. It proves public debate needs records, traceable transport, veterinary inspection, and accountable enforcement—not claims that “tradition” or “farm-raised” settles the question.

Claims need records

“Farm-raised” cannot function as proof without licensing, origin records, transport documents, quarantine controls, and inspection results. “Tradition” cannot excuse stolen companion animals, illegal transport, poison bait, or regulatory breaches when authorities document them. Each claim requires a named agency, date, location, and accessible record. Without those, no honest campaign should present an unverified raid, arrest, conviction, or pet-theft story as fact.

Biosecurity cannot run on promises

Rabies is transmitted when infected saliva enters bites, scratches, broken skin, or mucous membranes. Once clinical symptoms appear, rabies is virtually 100% fatal. After possible exposure, wash wounds with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes and seek urgent medical assessment. Post-exposure prophylaxis can include vaccination and, when indicated, rabies immunoglobulin or approved monoclonal antibodies. Properly cooked meat is not an established rabies transmission route. Household exposure incidents and commercial supply chains are separate risks; both require competent veterinary control.

Vietnamese families, pet owners, veterinarians, and local leaders deserve transparent enforcement and protection from illicit operators. SDE calls for complete abolition by 2030. WHO rabies guidance explains the medical stakes. Add your name to the national petition demanding action, then follow campaign updates reaching decision-makers.
